checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-close-surface.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao && go build -tags legacy -o "$tmp/ao-legacy" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" close --help >"$tmp/help"; "$tmp/ao-legacy" tick close --help >"$tmp/legacy-help"; grep -qx 'Usage:' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'ao close <id> <commit-message> <evidence-ref> [paths...]' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'ao tick close <id> <commit-message> <evidence-ref> [paths...]' "$tmp/legacy-help"; set +e; "$tmp/ao" close only-two args >"$tmp/out" 2>"$tmp/err"; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -eq 1; test ! -s "$tmp/out"; grep -qx 'Error: requires at least 3 arg(s), only received 2' "$tmp/err"
